events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Current web content included when drafting with Copilot in Word
events.titleJa: Word で Copilot を使用してドラフトするときに現在の Web コンテンツが含まれる
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Current web content included when drafting with Copilot in Word
events.summary: Draft with Copilot will include information from Bing search, resulting in content that's as current as what you would find when searching with Bing on the web.
events.summaryJa: Copilot を使用したドラフトには Bing 検索からの情報が含まれるため、Web 上で Bing を使用して検索した場合と同じくらい最新のコンテンツが得られます。
events.summaryEn: Draft with Copilot will include information from Bing search, resulting in content that's as current as what you would find when searching with Bing on the web.
